category_title: Respectful and self-regulated learners who internalize school values
minimal_context: A new senior learner is at the school for the first time and is expected to adapt to the strict behavioral rules and procedures.
dialogue:
TUTOR: As a new senior learner, you need to adapt to our rules here and follow the daily procedures.

STUDENT: Because of the way we used to behave at the school I am coming from, I am not used to doing things this way.

TUTOR: You just need to make sure you follow the instructions.

STUDENT: I am coming to this school for the first time and I find it a challenge to adapt to our rules here.

TUTOR: We expect everyone to abide by the procedures.

STUDENT: (Exhibits misbehaviour) I am just going to keep behaving the way I used to behave at my old school.

options.A: Provide counseling for the new senior learner and involve other professionals, such as social workers, to talk to them.
options.B: Add visual supports for the learner, such as a daily procedure schedule, school rules, social stories, or problem-solving cue cards.
options.C: Progressively and methodically tune the learner's awareness to each body part, followed by intentionally relaxing each part from toes to head.
options.D: Identify the stage that the new senior learner is at in the adaptation process using the four coping strategy model.
